# Third-party code served by joyshare

| File | What | Version | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| `three.module.min.js` | Three.js, the 3D library behind the progress scenes | r170 (0.170.0) | MIT, © Three.js Authors |

It is served from here so no visitor's browser contacts an outside server. It is only downloaded when a
video is being made and a scene is about to show. Source: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js
